input.summary:
Powder room furnished in parts/room-10.mjs: barrel and pot NE corner, rug, stair chair facing a washstand (cauldron, flower pot, glass-pane mirror, iron-bar cornice) on the south wall, hanging lantern plus a standing lantern. Checked on a bare test grid: fit OK, light 6+ on every floor cell but one barrel cell.
Not built into build.nbt: runParts refuses all 23 writes, because the mansion shell fills the room interior with air (shell.mjs:27) and runParts locks air-filled cells.
make.sh still writes a whole build.nbt (the powder room line shows 0 placed, 23 REFUSED).
left: Blocked by the lock, not by the design: parts/shell.mjs:27 fills every room interior with `air`, and runParts (build.mjs write/owned logic) treats that air as an earlier part's cell, so room-10's 23 writes are refused and the powder room is absent from build.nbt. Needs a decision outside this module: the shell should leave room air unwritten (default air, carve only walls and openings), or runParts should not lock air.

The real-build check is not run: `mcd room build.nbt --only "powder room"` says UNREACHABLE because the whole ground floor is still stubs (no corridor or entrance hall), so the walk verdict can't be checked here.
Lantern light is checked only on /tmp/pt17/test.nbt (a bare grid with walls, floor and ceiling, built by /tmp/pt17/test-room.mjs), not in the real build.
Doorway west x62 z56..57 is marked 'D' in the plan, but the chimney stack at x61..62 z56..57 may overlap it; check against roofs.mjs once it lands. The lane x63 z56..57 is kept clear.
plan.md Notes and elements.md were not edited (the powder room is part of the 'Bathrooms x5' item, which stays unticked).

waste.what: Discovered only after the first make.sh that the shell's air fill locks the room interiors, so every furniture write was refused. I found out by reading the make output and then grepping runParts; nothing up front told me that air in a room is owned.
waste.cost: one full make.sh cycle plus about 4 minutes of source reading in build.mjs
waste.tool: runParts (or the part-lock report) should say 'cell air-filled by <part>, room parts cannot furnish it' up front, and `mcd plan` should show which cells are owned by earlier parts

waste.what: Built a bare test grid by hand (floor, walls, ceiling, two doorways) to check fit and light, because the real grid can't be used while the shell locks air.
waste.tool: `mcd room --rooms rooms.json --only <room> --furnish <part.mjs>` (or a `--bare` flag that generates the room's walls, floor and doors) so the room designer can check walk, fit and light without the other parts

waste.what: Worked out the 6x7 floor layout by hand as character rows, and the lantern distances (Manhattan distance from a hanging lantern to each floor corner) to choose the second light.
waste.cost: about 6 manual iterations of the layers() rows and the light map
waste.tool: `mcd light` with a suggested-lantern list that picks the minimum number of lamps to make every floor cell 8+, not only the first one

companions.task: Confirm that the chair (dark_oak_stairs, facing north, bottom) and the cauldron/barrel bases are the right shape, and that the room's floor passes through the shell's air-fill without locking.
Stop filling room interiors with air in shell.mjs:27 so the room designers can add furniture into the carved air, or agree that carved air is a lock the rooms may write into.
